item.title: Showers likely in the next 24 hours
item.description: SCATTERED SHOWERS, isolated thunderstorms possible Saturday night through Sunday afternoon.Any thunderstorms would be isolated and may produce some strong wind gusts, but overall the threat is low. Rainfall amounts increase going east. Most of the area can expect less than 1/2 inch.-Greg@660weather

item.title: Little Apple news
item.description: The Little Apple, Vol 33 no 51, December 24, 2025Trash pickup for Appleton City will be Friday, December 26 this week because of the Christmas holiday.A reminder to Appleton City residents that taxes are due December 31. item.title: Obituary - Airen Joseph Andula
item.description: Airen Joseph, "Airbear" Andula, age 13, of Pleasanton, Kansas died Tuesday, December 22, 2025. He was born on September 18, 2012 in Kansas City, Kansas the son of Charles Andula and Anita Swan Gunn. He was a 7th grade student at Pleasanton Junior High School. Airen collected Hot Wheels and Legos. He attended East Side Baptist Church in Independence, Missouri. item.title: Harrisonville police ask for assistance regarding missing person
item.description: Daniel Potter has not been seen since December 22nd, at about 10:00 pm. He was last seen leaving his residence near Independence and Polk. Please contact the Harrisonville Police Department if you have any information on Daniel's whereabouts. 816-390-8940

item.title: Obituary - Larry Gene Shepard
item.description: Larry Gene Shepard age 76, of Appleton City Missouri, passed away Friday December 26, 2025, at home surrounded by his loved ones. He was born November 3, 1949, in Clinton Missouri to Elmore and Abby (McIntire) Shepard. He grew up on a farm in Johnson City, Missouri, where he learned about the life of farming and gardening at a young age. He graduated from Appleton City High School in 1967. item.title: A Whirlwind of honors due
item.description: The Lady Whirlwinds are the 40th Annual Midway Tournament Champions, and the boys were the runner up. Thanks to all the fans that showed up to support both teams. Also, congrats to Lexie Andrews, Abigail Sutton, Malayna Baer, Jackson Kash, and Michael Stevenson for being selected to the all tournament team.
